title: The Delayed Choice Quantum Eraser, Debunked
summary: Sabine Hossenfelder explains the delayed choice quantum eraser and argues it does not rewrite the past, as popular accounts claim. She walks through what the experiment actually shows.
why: HN recommends it as a clear debunking of the retrocausality interpretation of the quantum eraser.

quote.text: Later Sabine Hossenfelder did a video debunking the proposition that DCQE somehow showed that the past was being rewritten.
